stories.name_en: Juniper cost synergies target by end of fiscal 2028
stories.explanation: Objectif relevé, économies annuelles en rythme de croisière.
stories.story_fr: HPE vise 800 millions de dollars d’économies annuelles liées à Juniper d’ici fin de l’exercice 2028, contre au moins 600 millions précédemment.
stories.story_en: HPE now expects $800 million in annual run-rate savings from Juniper by the end of fiscal 2028, up from at least $600 million.
stories.citation: The company now expects $800 million in annual run-rate savings by the end of fiscal 2028, up from its previously announced target of at least $600 million.
